plugins.name: aci-risk-indicators
plugins.description: Read ACI Risk Indicators through the Aethon Credit Intelligence connector's seven tools: the modules, band search across providers, and, on the plans that include them, a provider's indicator and breakdown, side-by-side comparisons, portfolio composites, and positions resolved from their instrument identifiers to the providers behind them. Reports only what the tools return.

skills.name: aci-risk-indicators
skills.description: Use when the user asks about Aethon Credit Intelligence (ACI) Risk Indicators for digital asset yield providers and products — which modules exist, which providers sit in a module or risk band, one provider's indicator or breakdown, a side-by-side comparison, a portfolio composite, positions matched by their identifiers to the providers behind them, or a summary of these outputs for a committee. Reports only the fields the ACI connector returns.
